posts.headline: #FreeMaxx Champions💍 have the ring, but their own history says this repeat is a coin flip at best.
posts.detail: Tyrique14 hoisted the trophy in 2025, sure, but a career 14-14 mark and a 5.5 average finish across two seasons is not the resume of a dynasty — it's the resume of a team that got hot once. Prove it wasn't a fluke.

posts.headline: Put it in Ra has the best pedigree in the league and zero rings to show for it — that's the definition of a Cowboys problem.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and a ridiculous 1.5 average finish with back-to-back top-2 seasons screams contender, but adambarner111 still hasn't closed the deal. All that regular-season dominance means nothing until there's hardware.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is the Browns of Busters Anonymous, and the name has never been more ironic.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th place finish in their only season on record — 'talented tenth' is currently batting for the bottom tenth, and there's no evidence draft night changes that.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World won a title but has quietly been mediocre ever since, and nobody's talking about it.
posts.detail: Alxgalvn has a ring, but a 13-15 career mark and an 5.5 average finish with a worst finish of 8th means this 'contender' has been coasting on one good run. Time to show it wasn't a mirage.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh enters the season already carrying the second-worst finish in league history.
posts.detail: An 11th place debut on a 5-9 record is not a launching pad, it's a warning label. Until proven otherwise, this is a team drafting for next year already.
